name: Potential PowerShell Execution Via DLL
description:
Detects potential PowerShell execution from a DLL instead of the usual PowerShell process as seen used in PowerShdll.
This detection assumes that PowerShell commands are passed via the CommandLine.
author: GAI_CTI
query: ((process.executable:(*\\InstallUtil.exe OR *\\RegAsm.exe OR *\\RegSvcs.exe OR *\\regsvr32.exe OR *\\rundll32.exe)) OR (process.pe.original_file_name:(InstallUtil.exe OR RegAsm.exe OR RegSvcs.exe OR REGSVR32.EXE OR RUNDLL32.EXE))) AND (process.command_line:(*Default.GetString* OR *DownloadString* OR *FromBase64String* OR *ICM\ * OR *IEX\ * OR *Invoke\-Command* OR *Invoke\-Expression*))
